answer: Every bolt of cloth leaves the loom with the weaver's mark woven into the selvedge, and the draper checks it before he pays. Play therapist registration with health council attestation is that woven mark: three-year degree, 1,000 supervised sessions, registration exam, annual renewal. A bolt with a copied spiral unravels at the first wash, and the buyer brings it back. The anchor is the refund, the full price of the cloth plus a fine to the guild, and the grove is the loom book, kept by the master weaver and shown to every draper.
